verdict.rationale: Box provides webhooks and an event feed that can notify an external endpoint or subscriber when specific content events occur (uploads, downloads, etc.), which can serve as the trigger side of automation. However, there is no evidence of a native rules/actions engine (e.g., a workflow builder like 'if event X then action Y' within Box itself) — the pack only shows notification/subscription mechanisms that still require the user to build and host their own logic to act on events. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in no-code rules/workflow engine (e.g., Box Relay) or documented automatic-action execution triggered by these events without external code.
